incoming.name: Epaminondas
incoming.excerpt: By 395 BC Thebes, alongside Athens, Corinth, and Argos, found itself arrayed against Sparta (a former ally) in the Corinthian War.

incoming.name: Thrasybulus
incoming.excerpt: He was killed in 388 BC while leading an Athenian naval force during the Corinthian War.
